posts.title: Every Chick-fil-A chicken entree, ranked by protein per 100 calories
slides: Every Chick-fil-A chicken entree, ranked by protein per 100 calories.

slides.name: Grilled Nuggets, 8 count
slides.note: 130 calories, 25g protein. Nothing else on the menu is close, and it is not a diet item, it is just chicken with no breading and no bun.

slides.name: Grilled Chicken Sandwich
slides.note: 390 calories, 28g protein. The bun costs most of the density, and it is still the best sandwich on the board.

slides.name: Chick-fil-A Chicken Sandwich
slides.note: 420 calories, 29g protein. The most protein of any single item here, and third once you divide by calories.

slides.name: Spicy Chicken Sandwich
slides.note: 450 calories, 28g protein. Thirty more calories than the classic for the same protein.
